name: B10-0216/2026 (Verts/ALE) – New Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the new Chinese law on ‘ethnic unity and progress’ and the intensified suppression of ethnic identities
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on a new Chinese law on "ethnic unity and progress", adopted in March 2026. The Parliament says this law is used to suppress ethnic and religious minorities, including Tibetans, Uyghurs and Mongolians. It asks China to withdraw the law and stop discrimination. It also asks the European Union to sanction Chinese officials responsible for human rights abuses in Tibet.

- The Parliament asks the EU to sanction Chinese officials over human rights abuses in Tibet.
- It urges EU countries to suspend extradition treaties with China to protect people living in the EU.
- It asks EU bodies to raise human rights cases with China and at the United Nations.
